items.item: Status uses a consistent vocabulary with text labels, not colour alone
items.evidence: badgeMap gives text pills 'Đang chờ duyệt' / 'Đã duyệt' / 'Đã từ chối'; step labels are 'Đã duyệt', 'Đang chờ', 'Chưa đến lượt', 'Từ chối' next to numbered/check icons. Minor wording drift between header ('Đã từ chối', 'Đang chờ duyệt') and steps ('Từ chối', 'Đang chờ'), but always text-labelled.

items.item: Approval steps show approver, decision and absolute timestamp for each level
items.evidence: renderSteps: '<who> · <status label> · <at>' plus note, e.g. 'Lê Thu Hà · Đã duyệt · 03/11/2026 14:32' with the comment. Pending levels show approver and 'Chưa đến lượt' / 'Đang chờ' with no timestamp, which is expected because no decision exists yet. Approve/reject write absolute dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm via now().

items.item: Approve is the single primary action; Reject is secondary and requires a reason
items.evidence: #approveBtn is the only filled button (bg-blue-700) in the decision panel; #rejectBtn is outlined red. rejectBtn.onclick: if(!n){ showErr(); ... return; } with 'Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối.' and a red asterisk placeholder; confirm dialog follows. The page header has no competing primary action (audit headerPrimaryActions 0). Note: the '*' (#reqStar) is never un-hidden, minor.

items.item: Only the current approver can act; other users see why they cannot
items.evidence: renderDecision: can = status==='pending' && cur.uid===me; otherwise #cannotAct shows e.g. 'Bạn là người đề nghị nên không thể tự duyệt. Đang chờ ...' or 'Đang chờ <who> (<title>). Bạn sẽ duyệt ở bước N.' Role switcher #roleSel demonstrates it. Also handles approved/rejected end states.

items.item: Amounts are prominent, right-aligned in line items and formatted as currency
items.evidence: fmt uses Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN',{style:'currency',currency:'VND'}); line-item and footer cells are text-right num (tabular-nums), audit numericCells misaligned 0; 'Còn phải thanh toán' row is font-semibold and the header 'Tổng thanh toán' is semibold. Weakness: prominence is only weight, not size (14px) - borderline but accepted.

items.item: Attachments are listed with name, type and size and can be previewed or downloaded
items.evidence: #atts table columns Tên tệp / Loại / Dung lượng / Tải lên with 'Xem trước' (opens #prev dialog) and 'Tải xuống' buttons with aria-labels. Preview is a placeholder text and download only fires a toast (simulated), but the controls and metadata exist; an empty state is also provided.

items.item: A history timeline records every action on the request
items.evidence: #activity list 'Lịch sử hoạt động' with absolute timestamps for create, submit and step-1 approval; approve and reject handlers do state.activity.unshift({at, t}) so new actions are appended. Weaknesses: it is a plain list with no marker/line, the 'Xem lịch sử đầy đủ' link is dead, and the create entry says '0 ₫ → 86.450.000 ₫', which does not match the computed total 81.960.000 ₫.

notes: Clean, dense, restrained enterprise page: white sidebar with light-blue active item, 14px base, 4-6px radii, no gradients except the skeleton shimmer, no glass, no emoji, no uppercase tracking, no KPI tiles or greeting. Status pills are small rounded-full text badges (acceptable). The only possible tell is the skeleton linear-gradient, which is a loading shimmer, not decoration. Audit score 100. Data nit: creation entry amount 86.450.000 conflicts with the displayed 81.960.000 total (91.960.000 gross less 10.000.000 advance). Full-page screenshot not opened; verification was from source plus the first-viewport PNG.
